name: Tiny Yurts
tagline: Drag a path from the yurt to the farm. Keep the animals happy.
description:
A tiny path-drawing game in the spirit of Mini Motorways, small enough to have come 4th in js13k 2023. Your people live in yurts. Farms need tending. Draw a path with a finger or the left mouse button; right-click (or the red grid) rubs a path out. Score is settlers plus animals. You get a handful of path tiles each year — spend them well.

Pause to think; you can still draw. Fullscreen helps on a phone. Sound is a little plucked string, off if you like.

Your best score lives in the file. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend sees the score you have reached — each of you plays your own valley.

An unofficial port of Tiny Yurts by burntcustard (John). The farms, the yurts, and the animals are his.
